# Banded shield

Internal ID: ShieldBanded | Type: Shield | Source: Forge | Usage: Blocking | Wielding: Off-hand | Crafting Materials: Finewood x20, Iron x8 | Movement speed: -5%

# Introduction

The Banded shield is the second round shield. It has less block power compared to Iron tower shield but can more when used to parry enemy attacks.

## Upgrade information

• stat: Block armor | Quality 1: 42 | Quality 2: 48 | Quality 3: 54

• stat: Durability | Quality 1: 200 | Quality 2: 250 | Quality 3: 300

• stat: Crafting | Quality 1: 10 Finewood8 Iron | Quality 2: 10 Finewood4 Iron | Quality 3: 20 Finewood8 Iron | Total: 40 Finewood20 Iron

• stat: Forge level | Quality 1: 2 | Quality 2: 3 | Quality 3: 4

## Notes

• When crafting, players can customize the shield with a few different pre-set designs and colors by clicking the style button beneath the item name in the crafting window. The design cannot be changed afterward.

## Trivia

• The banded shield is sometimes known as "Viking Shield" in the game files.
